predictions.blurb: Oregon took a big poll hit, sliding from No. 6 to No. 21, but the metrics haven't followed: SP+ still has the Ducks ninth and FPI 13th. The models think voters overcorrected.
Oklahoma dropped from 11th to 24th in the poll, yet SP+ (14) and FPI (12) both still view the Sooners as a clear top-15 outfit. Plenty of room to climb back if the results follow.
BYU is up to No. 11 after sitting 15th, but both SP+ and FPI peg the Cougars 18th. The voters are out ahead of the numbers on this one.
Iowa climbed to No. 18 from 21st while SP+ has the Hawkeyes 25th and FPI is even cooler at 32nd. The résumé is outrunning the underlying profile.
Ohio State fell from No. 1 to No. 6 in the poll, but the models haven't budged: FPI still ranks the Buckeyes first and SP+ has them second. By the numbers, they're the best team in the country.
